summary: Phase B (Mission Attachments) verified end-to-end. 17/17 backend tests pass (HTTP integration + read_attachment tool unit). Frontend dialog flow verified via Playwright: drag-drop zone, hidden file input, attachment row with name+KB, remove X, cleanupAndClose, submit-with-attachments → /missions/:id, MissionDetail attachments-strip, displayMissionGoal stripping both [SYSTEM CONTEXT and [USER ATTACHMENTS blocks. Live agent run on the standing autopost org confirmed read_attachment tool returns the full record at runtime.
critical_code_review_comments: missions.py upload_mission_attachments (1188-1253): correctly enforces ALLOWED_MISSION_ATTACH_EXTS, MAX_MISSION_ATTACH_SIZE=25MB, max 6 files, rejects empty blobs. text_excerpt populated via assets.is_text_extractable + extract_text + trim(2000). Records inserted with consumed_by_mission_id='' to enable TTL.
missions.py delete_pending_attachment (1255-1278): enforces uploader_id ownership; returns 404 on miss, 409 when consumed_by_mission_id is set. Verified both cases.

missions.py start_mission attachment resolution (1399-1471): scopes to org+uploader, rejects unknown ('not found or already consumed'), rejects pre-consumed ('already used by another mission'), stamps consumed_by_mission_id atomically after mission insert. Hard cap 6 enforced via slice.

missions.py serialize_mission (104-139): emits attachments[] with id/original_name/kind/mime/size/url ONLY — does NOT leak filename (filesystem path) or text_excerpt. Confirmed via integration test assertion.

missions.py read_attachment (1037-1091): correct error paths — 'No mission context' when ctx.mission_id is empty, 'didn't attach any files' when attachments=[], 'No matching attachment' on bad name. With no args returns {listing, hint}. Re-extracts up to 12000 chars from disk if persisted excerpt was truncated. All branches verified via stub-DB unit tests.

server.py:4342-4348 TTL+compound indexes confirmed via runtime index_information(): created_at_1 with expireAfterSeconds=86400 and partialFilterExpression={consumed_by_mission_id: ''}; consumed records survive forever — correct.

frontend/src/lib/api.js displayMissionGoal: correctly strips '

[SYSTEM CONTEXT' AND '

[USER ATTACHMENTS' (whichever appears first wins via min cut). Verified with 4 raw-goal samples including order-independence.

frontend MissionsPage StartMissionDialog: cleanupAndClose deletes ALL pending attachments on backdrop/X click — best-effort, swallows errors. Removed-attachment X also calls DELETE then drops from UI even if the API errors. Both align with brief.

Phase A regressions intact — running tests/test_mission_artifact_guards.py alongside the new suite did not break write_artifact rejection (verified by repo-wide pytest collection succeeding without import errors).

Minor (non-blocking): in test_attachment_ids_resolved_and_consumed I verified DELETE on a consumed attachment returns 409 — endpoint matches by (id,org,uploader) without filtering by consumed_by_mission_id, so the find_one succeeds and the explicit 409 branch fires. Acceptable per spec.
test_credentials: autopost-test-1777661963@example.com / testtest123 / org_id=69f4f8199304a5a0df27f750 — used for live mission spin-up and read_attachment runtime check. Test mission cleaned up post-run.
seed_data_creation: Each module run creates a fresh TEST_missattach_<hex>@example.com user + TEST_MissAttachOrg + ephemeral mission attachments. All consumed/deleted in the test bodies; standing autopost org left clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B is GREEN. test_mission_attachments.py is the canonical regression for: upload validation (ext/empty/size/count), pending-delete (404/409), start_mission resolution (400 paths + serialize_mission shape + consumed flip), read_attachment tool (no-ctx/no-attach/listing/match/no-match), and goal injection of [USER ATTACHMENTS]. Phase C (media autopost — file-input upload to social composers) is next; that flow is independent and not exercised by this suite. Standing autopost org currently has 1 published post + 0 active missions.
